pool.text: If \(f'(x)\) is negative on (-\infty, 7) and (7, \infty), what occurs at \(x = 7\)?
pool.sol: Since \(f'\) changes as described, the First Derivative Test tells us \(x=7\) is a neither (no extremum).

pool.text: If \(f'(x)\) is positive on (-\infty, 6) and (6, \infty), what occurs at \(x = 6\)?
